Four rules:
1. afʿal does not agree when followed by ⁧مِنْ⁩ : ⁧هُوَ أَكْبَرُ⁩ , ⁧هِيَ أَكْبَرُ⁩ , ⁧هُمْ أَكْبَرُ⁩ .
2. It is diptototo (A2-08): nothing tanwīn, and the genitive takes -a. In pause reading you can't hear it.
3. After an indefinite name afʿal it works as an adjective, more... ⁧أُرِيدُ غُرْفَةً أَهْدَأَ⁩ I want a more room
Quiet, ⁧فُنْدُقٌ أَرْخَصُ⁩ It's a cheaper hotel.
4. The difference is expressed by ⁧بِـ⁩ : ⁧أَكْبَرُ بِسَنَتَيْنِ⁩ • greater than two years • ⁧أَغْلَى بِعَشَرَةِ يُورُو⁩ More expensive than ten

Many adjectives cannot enter the scheme afʿal: the parties ( ⁧مُزْدَحِم⁩ , ⁧مُمْتِع⁩ , ⁧مُرِيح⁩ ), the adjectives in -ī ( ⁧اِقْتِصَادِيّ⁩ ), those with more than three radicals and colors, which already have the shape afʿal. In such cases it is used ⁧أَكْثَرُ⁩ ... more than or ⁧أَقَلُّ⁩ The name of the indeterminate accused person (named after the name of the accused person) shall be followed by the following: tamyīz, "specification" (s):

⁧أَقَلّ⁩ is the normal way of saying ⁧القِطَارُ أَقَلُّ تَكْلِفَةً مِنَ الطَّائِرَةِ⁩ The train costs less than the plane. When the adjective has an opposite, one prefers that: instead of less distant, it is said ⁧أَقْرَب⁩ Closer. ⁧أَكْثَرُ مِنْ⁩ by numbers means more than ⁧أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مِلْيُونٍ⁩ More than one million ⁧أَقَلُّ مِنْ سَاعَةٍ⁩ It shall be less than one hour. With verbs ⁧أَكْثَرَ⁩ and ⁧أَقَلَّ⁩ are adverbs (accusative): ⁧يَعْمَلُ أَكْثَرَ مِنِّي⁩ "Works more than me" ⁧يَأْكُلُ أَقَلَّ⁩ It eats less.
The same afʿal also gives superlative, in three buildings.
Article + afʿal after the name (adjective) ⁧المَدِينَةُ الكُبْرَى⁩ the largest city

The construction is determined even if the second name is indefinite: it translates with the article. The second is used for one of the... ⁧مِنْ⁩ : ⁧مِنْ أَقْدَمِ الآثَارِ فِي العَالَمِ⁩ It is one of the oldest monuments in the world. and with the pronouns: ⁧أَصْغَرُهُمْ⁩ The youngest of them. ⁧أَفْضَلُكُمْ⁩ It's the best of you.
